name: ppt-master
description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
one_liner: Feed it a document or topic and it builds you a real, editable PowerPoint deck, with charts, animations, and even narration, instead of a flat image export.
buyer: A sales manager or consultant who needs client-ready decks fast and can't justify hiring a designer for every pitch.
business_use_cases: A sales team turns product one-pagers into polished pitch decks for prospects in minutes instead of days.
A consulting firm converts research reports into client-presentable slide decks with charts auto-generated from the data.
A course creator turns written lesson notes into narrated slide decks for an online course.

money_ideas.idea: Run a 'deck-in-a-day' service: clients send a document, you deliver a branded, narrated PowerPoint using this tool.
Offer a hosted version with company-branded templates and team seats.

steal_this: This weekend, build a 'document to pitch deck' service: take a client's existing report or one-pager and turn it into a narrated, on-brand PowerPoint using their own .pptx template.
